$comment: World-flag registry for data/adventures/DESIGN.md (arc 1) and DESIGN_ARC2.md (arc 2, arc.crown.*). In descriptions, loc:<id> and fac:<id> reference lore.json ids. setBy/readBy name scene ids, chapter ids, or specials: ending, side_quests, defeat_outcomes, companion_quests.

flags.description: Hero spotted the seven-tooth chalk sigil at the loc:millbrook well; gives advantage persuading the Reeve.
Reeve Hollis Tamsin of loc:millbrook; friendly gives a letter of introduction and a Ch4 militia.
Hero obtained the list of missing villagers (or the miller's confession); advantage on tracking.
Group Stealth succeeded approaching the barrow; fac:hollow_choir cultists are surprised.
Number of the four Millbrook captives freed alive from the Tithe Altar.
Pip Hallard, the miller's son, survived; he becomes a page of fac:order_of_the_dawn_lance.
Fate of Brother Ashby, the fac:hollow_choir cell leader of loc:millbrook.
Hero rekindled the barrow shrine of Thaloren; fac:briarkin and Nettle warm to the hero.
Hero remembers the Cantor's voice from the Tooth-dream; lowers the masque Insight DC from 17 to 12.
Widow Marrow's stolen ring was returned; shop discount now, potions of heroism in Ch4.
Where the hero took the Tooth of Want: loc:ravensgate (fac:lantern_wardens) or loc:brightwater (crown magistrate).
Holder of Tooth 1, the Tooth of Want, from the loc:millbrook barrow. Giving it to the Brightwater magistrate sends it silently to the Almonry (choir).
Holder of Tooth 2, the Drowned Tooth, from loc:drowned_abbey.
Holder of Tooth 3, the Briar Tooth, kept by Grandmother Wick of fac:briarkin at loc:thornwife_hollow.
Holder of Tooth 4, the Brass Tooth, from the vault on loc:isle_of_brass_parrots; fac:red_gull_brotherhood may secure it.
Holder of Tooth 5, the Singing Tooth, taken from the sea hag of loc:singing_reef.
Holder of Tooth 6, the Sky Tooth, sealed under Dawnbreaker in loc:ruins_of_old_vaelthorn.
Holder of Tooth 7, the Ember Tooth, lodged in Pyrraxis at loc:emberpeak.
Derived: number of Teeth held by the player or an ally (holder not unclaimed/choir). Recomputed by the flag engine.
Derived: number of Teeth held by fac:hollow_choir. Reaching 7 during the finale opens loc:the_maw.
Fate of Mother Sallow, fac:hollow_choir plague-preacher of loc:hollowmere; captured gives a Cantor clue.
Grandmother Wick of fac:briarkin: ally gives the Name-Chant (+1 seal); burned spawns curse-hunters.
Abbot Cendric of loc:drowned_abbey survived; he leads the Ch5 bell rite.
Hero holds the fac:briarkin cure for the Whispering Sickness (bell-ash delivered).
Fate of loc:hollowmere: cured (fac:briarkin), purged (fac:lantern_wardens) or abandoned to fac:hollow_choir.
How the Whispering Sickness is being fought across Orrimar; readable by future arcs.
Clue 2: the Almonry seal on plague grain in loc:port_sorrel.
Clue 3: the fac:hollow_choir ledger from loc:wreckers_cove.
Side taken in the Isles: fac:red_gull_brotherhood (with fac:tidewright_guild) or fac:saltwind_trading_company.
Status of the free port loc:gullhaven run by fac:tidewright_guild.
Fate of Governor Cassius Pell of fac:saltwind_trading_company.
Fate of Captain Harrow Vey, fac:hollow_choir smuggler-captain.
Hero traded memories to the sea hag of loc:singing_reef (lost proficiency until restored).
Who got the Brass Parrot treasure of loc:isle_of_brass_parrots.
Clue 4: fac:ironvault_consortium ledgers tie the Almonry to Choir funds.
Holder of the holy lance Dawnbreaker (dragon_slayer) of fac:order_of_the_dawn_lance.
Fate of Vosk the Hollow, fac:hollow_choir archivist-mage.
Hero knows the Cantor is Lady Seraphine Vell, Royal Almoner of fac:crown_of_aurelmark.
The Cantor was exposed before the court of loc:highcrown.
Aurek betrayed the hero and warned his aunt; clean escape in the palace undercroft.
Hero is wanted by fac:crown_of_aurelmark or fac:saltwind_trading_company law.
Queen Isolde Varannis of fac:crown_of_aurelmark survives the Cantor's poison.
loc:millbrook fights for the hero (war council ally, halves Highcrown fire).
Allies gathered at loc:dawnspire_keep (0-6).
Fate of the red dragon Pyrraxis of loc:emberpeak.
loc:lantern_hold survived the siege; fac:lantern_wardens hold the Maw rim (+1 seal).
All nine drowned bells of loc:drowned_abbey were rung (+1 seal, advantage vs Hunger Pull).
Outcome of the redemption parley with the Cantor in loc:the_maw.
Fate of the Cantor, leader of fac:hollow_choir.
State of loc:the_maw after the finale; readable by future arcs.
Ser Corwin Ashvale, dismissed knight of fac:order_of_the_dawn_lance.
Corwin approval 0-100; <=20 at loc:dawnspire_keep makes him leave.
Corwin resolved "The Broken Oath" (knighted or Thane exposed).
Nettle, fac:briarkin hedge-witch apprentice.
Nettle approval 0-100; <=20 at loc:the_maw makes her betray the party.
Nettle learned her true name ("The Name in the Jar").
Rook Marrowby, fac:red_gull_brotherhood smuggler.
Rook approval 0-100; <=20 at loc:port_sorrel makes him sell a Tooth.
Rook cleared his debt ("Debt of Salt") and owns a sloop.
Aurek Vell, Veyran scholar and nephew of the Cantor.
Aurek approval 0-100; <=20 at the masque makes him warn his aunt; >=70 enables redemption.
Aurek recovered his father's reverse-song research ("Veyra's Lantern"; +1 seal).
Heroic-mode defeats suffered this campaign.
Hero owes Grandmother Wick of fac:briarkin a favor.
Gold owed to fac:red_gull_brotherhood for salvage.
Hero saw a hollow coin crumble to ash at the loc:brightwater moneychanger's stall; opens the Ash in the Till side quest.
Clue 1: the ash coin's die mark is the fac:ironvault_consortium's own (Mistress Dunmore's assay).
Clue 2: the wererats were paid in true gold by a woman with two shadows.
Clue 3: Auditor Hesk does not know his own daughter's name (Insight).
Clue 4: the loc:deepanvil_hold vault ledger shows the tenth-hollow entry in Vexx's hand.
Clue 5: Mother Tallow sells faces and keeps a book of the unmade.
Clue 6: the foundry's imperial seal matches the Hollow Crown's mould. Any three clues let the hero name Vexx at the coronation.
The wererat mint under the loc:brightwater mill moved before the hero found it (2-day deadline).
Hero let the wererat go for the name of Vexx's courier; opens The Courier's Road.
Gilt, the doppelganger wearing Auditor Hesk, was unmasked and beaten; otherwise Gilt fights at the coronation.
Gilt fled when the hero named Hesk's daughter in public (the non-combat route); opens Hesk's Daughter.
Hero bought a face from Mother Tallow; usable once to walk into the coronation as one of the Faces, or spent by a defeat.
Captain Ferrin Salt lives and still holds the hero's unpaid marker; opens Salt's Marker.
A Face was crowned with the Hollow Crown (the False Coin ending).
Fate of Master Assayer Ondra Vexx; bargained = the hero traded her their own face.
The Unmade side quest returned the memory the hero sold to Mother Tallow.
Hero paid Mother Tallow with a memory (scar 'the memory of a name'); opens The Unmade.
What became of the Hollow Crown: destroyed by Korrath's hammer, handed to the Crown, or kept by the hero (a future hook).
Brannoc Stonecount (arc 2 companion, DESIGN_ARC2 §9): recruited at korrath_shrine_oath.
Brannoc Stonecount's loyalty 0–100 (starts 50; ≤ 20 may leave).
Sister Ilse Varn (arc 2 companion, DESIGN_ARC2 §9): recruited at ironvault_court.
Sister Ilse Varn's loyalty 0–100 (starts 50; ≤ 20 may leave).
Wren Thistle (arc 2 companion, DESIGN_ARC2 §9): recruited at fennicks_rest_hall.
Wren Thistle's loyalty 0–100 (starts 50; ≤ 20 may leave).
